slug: 2026-02-24 Kenya streamlines access to legal and digital identity
note: Reports the President's assent, by 24 February 2026, to the Births and Deaths Registration (Amendment) Bill 2024, which requires at least one births and deaths registration office in each of the 290 sub-counties. It says only that the country is 'making progress on digitalizing civil registration', with no system, office count or method; the 290 is a count of offices required by law, not of offices entering digitally.
